pay_detail: Cost not stated on the page I read
duration: 1 week, 1 college credit (page lists June 23 to 27, 2025)
deadline_text: The page I read only shows 2025 dates (June 23 to 27, 2025) and says registration is closed for TEAM 2023. 2027 dates and deadline are not posted there.
how_to_apply: The page has an Apply Now button, but its registration status shows 2023. Contact techrecruit@purdue.edu or 765-494-4935.
name: TEAM Camp (Technology, Engineering and Math)
what_you_do: A week on the Purdue campus to try tech degrees and careers. It focuses on high school girls. Polytechnic students are your counselors. You earn one college credit.
who_can_apply: Rising 9th, 10th and 11th graders. The 2025 page says the camp has a focus on high school female students. Age limit not stated.
notes: This page looks old (2025 dates). Check Purdue Polytechnic and the Summer College site for current dates and cost before planning. Offered with Purdue Summer College for High School Students. The 2025 page lists $350 per person, including activities, lodging, meals and a camp t-shirt.
